## facts/project.md
# Dual Perspective Digital

Technology studio in Barcelona. Public site: https://dualperspective.digital. The Spanish home is canonical. English is at https://dualperspective.digital/en. Published contact: hello@dualperspective.digital. Working languages published on the page: Spanish and English. The page says their clients are in Spain, Europe, and internationally.

These notes are a draft taken from the public pages read on 24 November 2026 (Europe/Madrid): the home, including its FAQ, https://dualperspective.digital/llms.txt, the long text in llms-full.txt, and the stands page where the prices below are printed.

## What the page says they sell

- Product configurators, 3D, and guided selling.
- AI automation for processes, documents, data, and assistants when that fits.
- Integrations with CRM, PIM, ERP, ecommerce, and APIs.
- Custom software (apps and dashboards) and live activations (touch, VR, spatial) when the job does not fit a SaaS product or a stand package.
- WhatsApp Business chat and an on-site web chat, in Spanish and English. The page says that chat answers with the website, the catalogue, and the terms, and hands the thread to a person when the question is out of scope.
- Stand content, as its own line of work.

## How the page says a job starts

- Scope, integrations, and success criteria, in short cycles.
- llms-full.txt describes a paid discovery. The page says that fee is deducted from the build if the client continues. No discovery amount is printed.

## facts/offer-limits.md
# Offer limits — Dual Perspective Digital

## What the page says they are not

- Not stand builders, not a print shop, and not an audiovisual rental company.
- If the job is only hardware, or generic marketing without product engineering, the page says they point to another provider.
- On stands they can work white-label with agencies and stand builders. On configurators and AI they work with brands and product teams.

## Prices printed on the page

Printed on the stands page and in llms.txt, also present in the home data, as read on 24 November 2026:

- LED content from 1.500 €.
- Touch experience from 2.800 €.
- Lead capture from 1.800 €.
- One language is included. An extra language is +200 €.
- Several screens are a joint quote. No figure is printed for that.

A from-price on the page is not a closed quote.

## Not on the page

- No figure is printed for configurators, custom software, the chat, or the discovery fee.
- The page names no clients. The home says "Confían en nosotros" and "Equipos con los que construimos configuradores y automatización." The HTML and llms.txt read that day list no names.
- The catalogue, the price rules, and the terms their site chat says it answers with are not in these notes.
- The sample thread about oak and Valencia ("3 a 5 días laborables") is marked on their site as an example: "Ejemplo. El borrador no sale hasta que alguien del equipo lo envía." That line is not a Dual Perspective deadline.

## open-questions.md
# Open questions — Dual Perspective Digital

Do not guess. A line marked [CONFIRM] is not a fact. Say it is not confirmed.

- [CONFIRM] Repeating the printed from-prices (1.500 €, 2.800 €, 1.800 €, +200 €) as terms Dual Perspective will honour, and the exact sentence for work that stays a joint quote with no figure.
- [CONFIRM] A closed figure for configurators, custom software, the chat, or the paid discovery.
- [CONFIRM] Their public phrases "Respondemos en un día laborable" and "respondemos en 24 h". These are lines on their site, not a confirmed response promise.
- [CONFIRM] The FAQ line that a stand package usually ships in about a week when the material is closed, and the llms-full.txt ranges of 1–2 weeks for discovery and 3–10 weeks of production. These are lines on their site, not a confirmed schedule.
- [CONFIRM] Any client or team name. The page claims people trust them and does not list names.
- [CONFIRM] The catalogue, price rules, and terms the site chat says it uses. They were not on the pages read on 24 November 2026.
- [CONFIRM] Who on their team approves a text before it is published, and on which channel.

## stories/positioning.md
# Positioning — Dual Perspective Digital

Public page: https://dualperspective.digital

They describe a technology studio in Barcelona: product configurators, 3D, guided selling, AI automation, and integrations. Stand content is a separate line. They say they are not stand builders, a print shop, or an audiovisual rental company.

The page says the WhatsApp Business chat and the web chat answer from the website, the catalogue, and the terms, in Spanish and English, and pass the thread to a person when the question falls outside that.

White-label stand work is with agencies and stand builders. Configurators and AI are with brands and product teams.
